key_highlights: ASX shares retreat as markets brace for an impending RBA interest rate hike amid persistent inflationary pressures
Westpac posts a robust $6.8B profit but warns of an 11% property price decline as home values fall for the seventh straight month
Macroeconomic headwinds intensify with rising borrowing costs, $315B debt accumulation, and Wall Street volatility spilling into local equities

sectors.trend: Solid headline earnings offset by escalating mortgage stress and projected double-digit house price declines
sectors.implications: Net interest margins may peak while bad debt provisioning risks increase for major banks

sectors.trend: Deepening downturn with seventh consecutive monthly fall in home values and weakest auction clearance since 2020
sectors.implications: Severe capital value downgrades and softening yields across residential and leveraged commercial REITs

sectors.trend: Gold facing price capitulation despite active domestic exploration; selective interest in critical minerals like manganese
sectors.implications: Margins under pressure for precious metals producers while junior exploration requires strict capital discipline

sectors.trend: Traditional retail falters under cost-of-living constraints, though select branded assets attract M&A interest
sectors.implications: Divergence between distressed legacy department stores and takeover targets with international brand equity

sectors.trend: Power tariffs set to surge as thermal coal capacity retires ahead of renewable replacement
sectors.implications: Wholesale price volatility elevates input costs across energy-intensive sectors, benefiting uncontracted generation

key_themes: Monetary tightening cycle inducing a sharper and prolonged macroeconomic slowdown
Housing market distress driven by escalating borrowing costs and subdued auction clearance
Corporate restructuring and white-collar retrenchment in professional services
Global equity market contagion from Wall Street sell-offs

risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase cash weightings and overweight non-cyclical defensive dividend stocks
Underweight residential property developers, leveraged REITs, and subprime credit providers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Contagion & Rising Cost of Capital
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge equity exposure via index puts and reduce exposure to highly leveraged corporate debt

opportunities.recommendation: Selective positioning in M&A consumer plays
opportunities.rationale: Takeover interest in Rip Curl owner demonstrates opportunistic offshore valuation arbitrage despite local headwinds
Long-term tech-driven manganese and battery metal demand supported by institutional research partnerships

defensive_moves.rationale: Upcoming RBA rate hike and Wall Street volatility present immediate downside pressure on index multiples

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive bank and property exposures
defensive_moves.rationale: Forecast 11% property decline and multi-month housing price slump threaten loan book growth and credit provisions

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish over 1–3 months as the ASX digests anticipated RBA rate increases and further residential asset devaluation.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued recovery over 6–12 months contingent on terminal rate clarity, inflation moderation, and stabilized housing credit demand.
key_catalysts: RBA Board interest rate decision and revised economic forecasts
Upcoming quarterly Australian CPI and retail trade figures
US midterm election impact on global risk appetite
Australian major bank full-year earnings and credit impairment guidance
watch_list: CoreLogic 5-capital city home value index and clearance rates
Global commodity benchmarks (Iron Ore, Gold, Crude Oil)
